wrapperFormat.commentary: Every tool result is delivered as a [result] element containing [name] (the tool name) and either [output] (success) or [error] (failure). Harness-side validation errors (Edit mismatches, unknown TaskStop ID) nest a [tool_use_error] element inside [error]; runtime failures (Read EISDIR / not found, Bash nonzero exit) put the message directly inside [error]. Parallel calls in one turn return one [result] per call in the same order. Some notices (Read token-cap truncation) arrive as a separate system-injected block after the [result], not inside it.
